recipes.name: Philly Cheese Steak
ingredients_raw: 1 pound fresh steak (rib-eye, round, or sirloin)*

steps.text: Add oil to a large non-stick skillet. Saute onions and 2 tablespoons of teriyaki sauce until the onions are soft. Add the sliced meat and cook until meat browns slightly, add remaining 1 tablespoon of teriyaki sauce and stir to combine. Place cheese on the meat and stir until melted, mixing meat, onions and cheese together. Scoop meat mixture onto sandwich rolls.

raw_recipe.headline: Philly Cheese Steak
raw_recipe.description: An Asian-inspired version of a Philly cheese steak--thinly sliced steak is cooked with onion, cheese spread, and a splash of teriyaki sauce, and served on sandwich rolls.

review.reviewBody: I loved this recipe, it was easy to make and my husband loved it! I'm the Philly Cheese Steak eater... but I'm glad I was able to convert him! Now there will be many more Philly nights.

It was just OK using cheese spread and Teriyaki sauce, but it was great when I left out the teriyaki sauce and cheese spread, then I added sliced peppers with the onions added the steak slices to the pan and cook until the steak was done. Put the steak, onion and peppers on a roll and top with American cheese for me and Swiss cheese for my wife. Just put S&P on the steak to taste, put it under the broiler to melt the cheese a little( Don't melt the cheese in the pan with the steak, onions and peppers.) Now it gets five stars.
 If you truly want a Philly Cheese Steak don't use Steak-Umms or cheese spread really.

Made with all ingredients including fresh garlic. Seasoned with pepper, garlic powder & onion powder. Had the Kikkoman Teriyaki marinade but instead of putting on onions, put directly on meat in a bowl (only left on for 2 - 3 mins). Sauteed onions & fresh garlic in olive oil constantly stirring until slightly soft. Pushed to side of pan, put steak in middle of pan. After first side done, pushed onions & garlic back to middle of pan, turned steak over & put on top of bed of onions until steak was almost done. Put 3 pieces of Provolone cheese on top, covered pan for about two mins - when cheese was all melted - turned off stove. DELICIOUS!!!

I didn't do the teriyaki sauce I cooked the steak in worcestershire sauce and kens zesty Italian sauce. I used provolone cheese slices for the cheese too. But very delicious. I cooked both the onions and peppers and steak on medium high heat. I toast the hoagie rolls too (or sub rolls).

It tried this recipe and it was really good. I did do my own twist on it tho. I used kikkoman soy sauce since I didn't have the teriyaki sauce and sauteed my onions with that and pepper, bold and spicy seasoning, and garlic powder. And added the steak slices and simmer it all together. Then I add my cheeses which was queso blanco, shredded Mexican blend, and shredded mozzarella cheese. Mixed together while hot. Then add Mayo on the sides of hoagie bread, placed the meat with cheese and top off with ketachup, and southwestern ranch. Also did this same recipe with left over baked chicken shredded up. Came out so good!

Simple and to the point, I used thinly sliced steak and the onions and teriyaki sauce as recommended in the recipe. I did add peppers (red and yellow) as well and, when I realized that the only cheese spread was spicy Queso, I decided to use provolone slices instead, covered the pan and melted it onto the steak. The whole family loved it. Will make again soon!

1/2 jar Cheez Whiz
Was questioning the Kikoman Soy Sauce but it was very good. Just sprinkled it over the onions & peppers & again after putting the meat in. Really delicious & I will make it again for husband & I.

This was supper easy. I got a pack of stir fry meat at the grocery store, cut those in half then cooked as stated minus the onion. In another pan fried up the onion and added peppers for those who eat them here. My oldest deemed it "The most awesome supper ever" lol. Definitely will make again sometime.
Good choice. Tweeked recipe by using a crock pot on high for 4 hours and adding beef broth. Reminded my husband of beef roast on a hoagie roll. Will do again!

Delicious! I didn't have teriyaki sauce and used sweet & sour sauce instead -- came out just as good. Also added green peppers and used Swiss or Provlone cheese and melted it under the broiler for a couple minutes.
I added char-roasted red peppers and used Stubbs sweet pepper anytime sauce instead of teriyaki
EASY!!!

simple, straight forward. 

I would tweak and add some mushrooms and a little more meat but I feel like that's self preference. it's a simple recipe and is quick to dish out.

My family loved this meal. I made it just as directed with no changes. It was delicious.
No I didn't make any changes, and it was quite yummy. Yes I will make it over and over again. The next time I'll make a dipping sauce, I like mixing things up.

This is not how a the original Philly cheese steaks are made. We call the Asian steaks. The orginial Philly cheese steaks are with onions, American cheese, steak and a roll. Pizza steaks has sauce, mozzarella cheese, onions and mushrooms, green papers if you want. The cheese steak hoagie is with mayo on the roll, lettuce, tomatoes and onions, depends if you want the onions raw or cooked. Mushroom steak has steak, onions, mushrooms, with Swiss cheese. Some people put hot peppers, sweet peppers, ketchup or mustard. If you put the roll in the oven after it is made for a minute or two, then it is a cheese steak grinder. We have been eating these decades before the Asian steaks came along. I tried it once, didn't like the taste. I don't really too many people eat them here other then the Asians.

Im only giving it 3 because, well; Im sure its a good recipe.. it is steak after all, but I come to this site to learn how long to cook something and on what level heat. This person, like so many others; I guess assumes people know what the timing and temp should be, but if we did why would we come to a cooking site right ?? :)
